text:
taylor_ae: Quick one  Acme procurement says they can wire today but legal wants DocuSign. They asked: 'can we wire and provide PO later?'

maria_legal: short: we don't accept unrestricted wire-before-sign. Acceptable options: (1) DocuSign now, wire on receipt, or (2) wire to escrow/holdback with exec email authorization + PO including tax ID and wiring_authorization note.

owen_finance: For AP to process wire we need PO mapping fields. Minimal PO we require: PO number, amount, currency, billing entity, tax id, wiring_authorization text. If wire happens before countersign, include remittance note linking to PO and exec approval.

ria_se: For the POC we must confirm KMS and dedicated pool. We'll provide a KMS attestation PDF and a short runtime isolation note. Note: customer-managed HSM supported but onboarding is ~2-3w and won't start until contract flow is confirmed.

taylor_ae: They also bumped SLA ask: 30% credit for >1h outage. We typically do monthly cap 25% and per-incident cap 10%. Can legal/finance hold on that?

maria_legal: Recommend standard SLA. Draft wording: "Service credits up to 25% of monthly charges; per-incident cap 10%. Uptime measured by Redwood telemetry per SLA appendix." Add exclusions for customer misconfig and force majeure.

own_finance: If we accept a holdback flow, finance can accept wire with a 10% retention instruction in remittance plus exec email. Escrow account is slower (bank setup).

ops-bot: Uploaded templates -> orderform_v6.pdf and msa_redline_v4.docx at https://redwood.co/drive/acme-poc (perms: sales,legal,finance).

taylor_ae: I'll push procurement to DocuSign and share the KMS attestation now. If they insist on wire-first I'll propose 10% holdback + exec email + PO with tax id. Tagging @maria_legal and @ria_se to prep docs. :thumbsup:
